programmes.d: The humans join the fight at sea; Ushio and Tora find themselves at the mercy of Hakumen's most dangerous form.
Momo is stuck in her darkness form! Without the ability to control her strength, Momo unintentionally destroys whatever she touches.
Hakumen, driven mad with hatred, hunts down the spear; Ushio and Tora make an impossible choice.
Shamiko can't use her magic rod right because of a lack of imagination. Special training in Lilith's sealed space will help her. Maybe.
The Demon Lord is defeated by a human hero; to find his replacement, the demon kin hold a competition; Helck, a human and mortal enemy, is among the participants.
A chaotic summer break ends, and a new school semester begins with Mikan transferring into Shamiko's class.
Helck continues to rack up victories as a fan favorite of the crowd; he proceeds on to the semifinals race.
Shamiko and Momo enter Mikan's heart to negotiate with Ugallu, the entity responsible for the magical girl's curse!
Helck displays a lot of strength and leaves Vermilio increasingly concerned about the threat he poses.
Hiraku won't waste his second chance at life; he will focus on what truly matters. And so, he builds a new home with his own two hands.
After Helck blocks an attack meant for Edil, Vermilio becomes convinced that he is an enemy; the floor gives way and everyone falls into a dark underground room.
As the weeks turn into months, Hiraku's loneliness grows. He thought he desired a life of solitude, but his wish for companionship grows stronger by the day.
The power of the gate sends Vermilio and Helck to a remote island; Vermilio travels deeper into the island and comes across a fluffy creature.
Hiraku and Lu begin their new life together, unaware of the visitors who will soon arrive at their household.
Vermilio poses a question to Helck about fighting against old friends; the others at Castle Urum are fighting winged knights.
Now that they've secured a reliable water source, they can start a rice paddy and build a bathhouse.
Hyura and the others escape Castle Urum, but soon find themselves surrounded again; Azudra arrives to subdue the winged knights; Azudra begins plotting.
With their homestead completed, they turn their focus to food preparation and just in time; Winter is coming.
Azudra determines the winged knights are a major threat; Helck and Vermilio take it easy.
A surprise attack would have shattered their peaceful lives were it not for the almighty farming tool. As word spreads, their home blooms into a village.
Helck and Vermilio bid farewell to the mysterious island and its residents as they sail away with a stowaway Piwi aboard; they run into a massive whirlpool.
Hiraku realizes the importance of diplomacy when the demon lord and the dragons establish contact with the Great Tree Village.
Helck and company end up in the Erille Kingdom where they must fight the barbarians of the Tothman Tribe; the Tothman King goes berserk after tapping into a mysterious power.
Helck and company use their winnings from the cooking competition to buy a map leading to the Empire; they make plans to go northwest into the ruins of two destroyed kingdoms.
They say civilization started because of alcohol. In the Great Tree Village's case, it instigates a misunderstanding between dragons.
Vermilio is frightened by Helck's power as he goes berserk during his battle with Augis; it makes her recall the words of the Great Witch who warned her about Helck.
Hiraku's offhand remark leads to a series of events that conclude with a merchant, establishing trade relationships with The Great Tree Village.
When they were little, Helck and his younger brother Cless lost both of their parents; one day, Cless gets very sick and Helck begs for someone to save him.
Spurred by her followers, the demon lord's daughter attempts to invade the Great Tree Village. “Attempts” being the keyword.
Only half a month after Cless departs on his expedition, monsters begin to appear in greater numbers than ever before; the kingdom enacts a military draft to combat them.
News of the impending birth thrills the villagers, but they aren't the only ones interested in the good news.
Helck arrives at the Demon Lord's castle and senses a powerful presence; it turns out to be Azudra of the Four Elite Lords, who makes a plea for peace.
Hiraku's second chance was just the beginning. As he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.
Zeruzeon reveals the kingdom's terrifying plan, so Helck and his friends sneak into the castle to put a stop to it by saving Cless.
With the park beginning to prosper, Kanie and Sento begin to interview for more staff, but Sento is a little... on edge about it.
Helck is on the verge of being killed; to save the life of his big brother, Cless is forced to make a choice.
With summer in full swing, Amagi's water park is open. However, the shark mascot, Jaw discovers something fishy in the machine room, and danger may be lurking in the waves!
Helck charges onward, but an army of bounty hunters stands between him and Alicia; she is in horrible shape as she faces public execution.
Dating customers is against cafe policy, but Erika promised one a date if he wins an eating contest. Misa competes to save her, but then Hinata joins, with his sights on her!
Helck's motivations become clear with an awakening of a horrific truth; Vermilio vows to fight by Helck's side.
Hinata and Usui's rivalry flares as Hinata tries rekindling childhood memories with Misa. Meanwhile, the cafe holds a Maid Witches cosplay event, but can maid magic help here?
The winged knights continue attacking Castle Thor to level themselves up further; Asta keeps snooping for information in the human realm.
Hinata reminiscences about his past. Maid Latte hosts a Fortune Telling Day and Erika the fortune teller gives Usui a depressing fortune regarding his future with Misaki.
Zeruzeon leads the winged knights in an assault on the newly rebuilt castle; humans and demons become locked in combat.
At the festival together, Misaki and Usui end up joining the Love Trial. The prize: a ticket to the after-party, and the only rule is that they must hold hands the whole time!
Misaki, the iron-fisted student council president, hides a secret: she works in a maid cafe! She's discovered by the most popular guy in school; what's his price for silence?
Raphael's army attacks a demonkin outpost when Helck and Vermilio arrive; Raphael determines Vermilio is Helck's newfound source of support.
Helck faces off with his former friend, Alicia; Vermilio can't help but be concerned about Helck as she continues to fight with Raphael.
Misaki's secret is spreading; now the Three Idiots are onto her too! Worse, the school festival's coming, and Class 2-2's about to rebel! One single mistake could expose her!
Akane copes with her trauma by being popular and working hard to make people like her, but one boy in her class doesn't care about her at all.
It's Little Sister Day at the cafe. Misaki can't get into the role, but a severe scolding by Honoka makes her turn her act around. Misaki nails the parté until Takumi arrives.
Reincarnated as the son of Baron Kagenou, Cid bides his time as Background Character A while preparing for the day he can finally become the Eminence in Shadow.
The cafe gets a celebrity guest: Aoi, a net idol. She's eager to work in the cafe, much to Satsuki's chagrin. When Takumi helps out in the kitchen, Aoi sets her sights on him!
The princess is supposed to reject the background character's confession, not accept it.
Satsuki warns Misaki about a group of stalkers targeting cosplay cafes, but she isn't worried. On this night, however, the boss is late and Misaki has to close shop alone.
The mistake those with power make is believing that they are the ones in control.
Misaki has new fans at school- the Inuyama brothers. They want to know all about her, but this will reveal her secret. Should she tell them the truth and risk her reputation?
Cid is not facing a minion, but a would-be knight of the rounds; an atomic bomb has no reason to fear the gnashing of a lowly pest.
Sakura wants to confess her feelings to her crush, Nozaki. Unfortunately, when she does, he thinks she is just a fan of his shojo manga.
While Iris seeks a bright mind to study an artifact, Cid visits a popular store; in the dark corners of the city, someone commits murders in Shadow Garden's name.
Nozaki's friend and fellow manga artist Mikoshiba pays a visit. Considering Mikoshiba is pretty much Nozaki's foil, Sakura can't figure out how or why the two are friends.
Cid gets a report from Nu about powerful cult members lurking in the Royal Capital; he is too distracted by the upcoming fencing tournament to notice.
Sakura learns that she and Mikoshiba aren't the only ones helping Nozaki with his mangas. Concerned with who may be cozying up to Nozaki, Sakura is on a new mission.
Cid sacrifices his life to save Rose; unbeknownst to anyone else, Cid survives exactly as planned; his counterattack can begin.
Mikoshiba is invited to a mixer, but isn't sure about his social skills. Fortunately, with a little help from Nozaki and Sakura, he might be able to figure it out just enough.
When the students fight back, Shadow Garden joins the fray as their reinforcements; amidst the chaos, Cid confronts the Gaunt Knight.
When Sakura notices that Nozaki's apartment is pristine, she panics, worried that he's trying to impress another girl. What she discovers is even more irritating.
Cid heads to Lindwurm in response to a summons from Alpha, but he is not the only one traveling there; the annual Goddess' Trial is quickly approaching.
Nozaki gives Wakamatsu a gift to help him fight his insomnia, but what he doesn't tell him is that this gift may also be his worst nightmare.
The curtain rises on the Goddess' trial; when Cid is unwittingly called into the arena, he transforms into Shadow and faces none other than Aurora, the Witch of Calamity.
Nozaki needs inspiration for his artwork so Sakura decides to take him on what she believes is a date, but a few awkward encounters make her reconsider.
The door to the sanctuary opens and Alpha strides through it, intending to expose the cult's grave secrets; Cid also enters the sanctuary and reunites with Aurora.
Posing manga characters is a never-ending challenge for Nozaki, but two of his models may become a real life couple!
Alpha faces off against an empowered Nelson in a vicious battle; Cid and Aurora reach the Sanctuary's core, but a door only a hero can open blocks their path.
Sakura and Nozaki find themselves living in a real-life manga, but while Sakura daydreams of romance it's no surprise to find that Nozaki is completely clueless.
Cid's victory is short-lived when Nelson counters with his new magic; Alexia convinces Rose and Natsume to form an alliance to uncover the truth of their world.
The group has various repeated, awkward attempts at love, and it appears some people are catching on to who they are in Nozaki's manga.
Only the strongest warriors can advance in the prestigious Bushin Festival, but one contestant proves himself a feeble and mundane man with no talent.
Nozaki is up to his usual social experiments, and this time Sakura isn't the only one being tricked and observed! This time the guys are the focus.
Princess Rose flees to the north of the Royal Capital; the Oriana Kingdom wants to handle it internally as a purely domestic matter.
After numerous failed attempts at grabbing Nozaki's attention, it finally seems as though Sakura may have the perfect opportunity.
Cid recollects piano lessons from his past life; Epsilon's performance sets the soundtrack for something else.
Yuko didn't have horns or a tail when she went to bed last night! Now her mom's revealing the deep dark secret their family's been hiding for generations - What's going on!?
Cid and Claire receive an invitation to a tournament; at the festivities, Cid receives more attention than a background character desires.
Well it's time for Yuko to murderize a magical girl - but not before she gets in some exercise and spends her allowance, of course.
Doom tries to make war with Midgar; the match between Jimina and Iris begins.
Lilith contacts Yuko in her dreams with vital information she must remember. After all, Yuko needs all the help she can get! Say, why is Momo helping her anyways?
Provoked by the fight between Shadow and Beatrix, Iris joins the fray; an intense battle progresses across the Royal Capital; Rose runs into Alpha.
Wait a minute; there's a switch on the bottom of Yuko's ancestor statue. What happens if it's turned on? Later, Yuko needs cash fast cause she owes Momo A LOT of money!
Akane copes with her trauma by being popular and working hard to make people like her, but one boy in her class doesn't care about her at all.
Momo finally meets Ryoko. Later, the accident-prone Yuko must carry a FRAGILE and VALUABLE laptop home with her. What could possibly go wrong?
Reincarnated as the son of Baron Kagenou, Cid bides his time as Background Character A while preparing for the day he can finally become the Eminence in Shadow.
Yuko will need to go deeper into Momo's subconscious so she can implant the idea that will change everything! Perhaps compassion can triumph where fighting has failed.
The princess is supposed to reject the background character's confession, not accept it.
A change of fortune can only mean one thing: FOOD. Later, Yuko learns the hard way that she and Momo have vastly different definitions of "training."
The mistake those with power make is believing that they are the ones in control.
Mikan finally makes her debut, and Yuko's anxiety spikes to even higher levels! Is the magical girl here to murderize Yuko or for another reason?
Cid is not facing a minion, but a would-be knight of the rounds; an atomic bomb has no reason to fear the gnashing of a lowly pest.
